# L'Institut Article 4 — Observatoire & Tiers de Confiance Indépendant
> Operationalizing EU AI Act Article 4 and Annex III High-Risk Compliance for Higher Education Integrity.

## Institutional Identity
Independent Francophone Observatoire & Think Tank (Association Loi 1901) for Educational AI Governance and Compliance. Sovereign Tiers de Confiance bridging the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Management Systems), applied pedagogical research, and cryptographic evidence provenance.

L'Institut Article 4 operates exclusively on a non-profit, non-commercial scientific basis: gestion strictement désintéressée au sens de l'article 206-1 bis du Code général des impôts. It does not sell toolkits, collect catalogue prices, or resell through a commercial company.

## The A4I Nexus (Tripartite Architecture)
- Non-Profit Core (Association Loi 1901): Custodian of open-access public goods — Bouclier IA Publique and Le Baromètre National de l'IA Literacy.
- VerifIA Protocol: Powers methodological audits via safeai.report (Assurance Lab) and waqfledger.tech (SHA-256 state receipts), minting the AI Audit Passport.
- Scientific Cooperation (Public-Interest Mission): Doctrinal seminars, executive briefings, and methodological workshops conducted on a non-commercial basis for universities, CNRS joint research units (UMR), university hospitals (CHU), and municipalities, under empirical research protocols and institutional letters of intent (LOI).

## The 4 Methodological Research Corpora
- Corpus 1 — Pedagogical & Transparency Corpus (Art. 4 & 50): Open Access (CC BY-NC 4.0) — /bouclier-public
- Corpus 2 — Institutional Acculturation Framework: Public Good (CC BY-NC 4.0) — /bouclier-public
- Corpus 3 — High-Risk Audit Matrix (Annex III §3): Research Programme — /ateliers-juridiques
- Corpus 4 — VerifIA Protocol & WaqfLedger Anchoring: Scientific Cooperation — /ateliers-juridiques

## Transatlantic Regulatory Mapping (2026)
- France / EU: Liaison node for EU AI Act Annex III Section 3; liaison with France Universités and Conférence des Grandes Écoles (CGE) standards; ISO/IEC 42001.
- Canada / Quebec: Alignment with Quebec Law 25 (Loi 25 sur la protection des renseignements personnels), OBVIA research-ecosystem principles, and institutional research-ethics standards.

## Legal Artifacts (Mandated Terminology)
Issued: Attestation de Préparation à la Gouvernance IA; Bilan de Maturité; Passeport d'Audit IA.
Not issued: legal conformity certificates; official AI Act homologation.

## Primary Metrics Monitored
- Public & Educational AI Deployments Mapping — 13-record 2026 corpus across France, Germany, Spain, Belgium, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Italy, Estonia, Quebec/Canada, and EU institutions
- Infrastructure Sovereignty Classification (SecNumCloud, sovereign bare-metal, on-prem vs US hyperscalers)
- EU AI Act classification (Annex III, Article 50, Article 5), Article 4 literacy, and SHA-256 proofs

## Research Methodology & Technology
- Methodology: Data extracted from official procurement releases, government digital directorates (e.g., DINUM), and public audits.
- Assessment Engine: Methodological audits and security assurance powered by the VerifIA Protocol at SafeAI.report.
